baseline.description: Autonomously build or extend a full-stack application from a short prompt. Runs a Generator-Evaluator convergence loop. Use when asked to "build an app", "create a project autonomously", or "harness build".

root_cause_analysis.mechanism: brainstorming skill injects 'EXTREMELY IMPORTANT: MUST use before any creative work' via SessionStart hook, causing it to always trigger before harness for any 'build me an app' type query
eval_framework_limitations: run_single_query returns False if first tool call is not Skill/Read targeting the test skill
claude -p does not route /slash-command queries through the slash command system
--plugin-dir adds plugins but does not replace globally installed ones
root_cause_analysis.conclusion: Description optimization cannot overcome brainstorming priority in this environment. Primary trigger mechanism is /harness explicit slash command, which works correctly (100% in iteration-1 functional evals).

final_description: Autonomously build or extend a full-stack application end-to-end from a short prompt using a multi-round Generator-Evaluator convergence loop that iterates until quality thresholds pass. Trigger this skill when the user wants to build an entire app or major feature autonomously — phrases like "build an app", "create a project autonomously", "build it end-to-end", "just go build it", "iterate until it works", or any request describing an autonomous build-evaluate-refine cycle. Also trigger for /harness commands with any flags (--worktree, --max-rounds, --threshold). This is NOT for single-component creation, bug fixes, or code review.
